### Short Answer
The deadline for filing the quarterly percentage tax return is on or before the 20th day following the end of each taxable quarter.

### Controlling Authorities
This is established under Section 119 of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC), which outlines the filing requirements for percentage tax.

### Interpretation
Taxpayers are required to file their percentage tax returns quarterly, and the specific due dates are set for the 20th day of the month following the end of each quarter. For example, the deadlines for the first, second, third, and fourth quarters are April 20, July 20, October 20, and January 20 of the following year, respectively.

### Practical Meaning
It is crucial for businesses subject to percentage tax to adhere to these deadlines to avoid penalties and interest for late filing. Proper planning and timely submission of the returns will ensure compliance with tax obligations and help maintain good standing with the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR).
